correctness.rationale: Exact rooted-forest edge subset/root enumeration gives a normalized three-term generating polynomial for all positive a,b,q. Its factorization yields two independent Bernoulli variables, then a hyperbolic reduction to (1+vu)/(v+u)^2 for u>=1. The derivative has at most one interior zero and yields the exact threshold; equality is a quartic maximum. A standalone script independently checked 31,816 exact rational and numerical identities across parameters. Numerical checks are corroboration; the derivative proves the continuum result.

value.rationale: Varying fugacity is the natural multi-scale control parameter for rooted forests, while mean root count is monotone. The variance instead undergoes a sharp one-to-two fluctuation-scale transition, fully classified for the smallest possible connected network by exact edge-contrast thresholds, peak positions/heights and a quartic critical boundary. This is a complete natural boundary classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a rederivation of the known spectral formula.
